note: One table, two readers. desktop/src/lib/endpoints.test.ts asserts the webview's field predicates decide these verdicts; desktop/src-tauri/src/endpoint_field_parity.rs asserts the Deserialize impls of Hostname, SshUser, KeyPath, HostAlias and RemoteSocketPath decide the same ones. Rust is the authority: when the two disagree, the frontend moves. 'repeat' means the value repeated that many times, so a length bound can be pinned without a 4096-character literal. Empty values are deliberately absent - Rust refuses the empty string for all five types while the panel reads it as 'unset' and stores undefined, which is the single divergence and is pinned by its own test on each side.
